events.title: Mingle Launches December 14!
events.summary: We're excited to announce that Mingle is officially launching on Steam on December 14 2027!Jump into a crowd of quirky little characters and find your identical twin. Match, transform, and discover hundreds of characters across 25 levels, each with its own surprises.Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-opWe've been working on Mingle for quite some time, and we're excited to finally share the full game on Steam.In the meantime, you can play our free demo, and if you like it, wishlist Mi

events.title: Mingle is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Mingle is part of Steam Next Fest, and our free demo is out now!Jump into a crowd of quirky little characters and find your identical twin. Each successful match transforms you into someone new, with a new surprising way to play in each level.Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-opWe're a two-person indie team from New Zealand, and we'd love to hear what you think.If you enjoyed the demo, we’d love it if you leave us some feedback or wishlist Mingle to support us ahead of launch!Thanks

events.title: Mingle is in the Unmistakable Festival!
events.summary: Mingle is part of Unmistakable Festival, a celebration of art and animation in video games.The festival runs from October 8-12, featuring a daily livestream that takes you behind the scenes to see how the games' artwork was created.Watch the stream on October 12 to see how we bring Mingle's little characters to life!Check out Unmistakable Festival on Steam

events.title: Demo out now!
events.summary: The Mingle demo is out now!Download Mingle DemoJump into a the 4 unique levels and see if you can 3-star them all. Each time you finish a level you’ll meet a new character, each eager to tell you something strange.There’s also local co-op if you want to play with a friend on one keyboard, or with two controllers.If you have any feedback, you can fill out this short form or send us a message on Discord.Happy mingling :)Shannon and Sam (Cookiecrayon)SteamDiscordYoutube InstagramTiktokBlueskyX

events.title: 1,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: We've hit 1,000 wishlists on Steam!Big thanks to everyone supporting Mingle! With over 140,000 early prototype demo players on Itch, and over 30,000 players enjoying the special release of the motion-controlled version of the full game on Nex Playground, seeing this excitement carry over to Steam means everything to us. We're just getting started, and we can't wait to grow this community together!Don't forget to follow our socials for more updates about Mingle and other releases.Website, X, Blue
